title: Fifty Bookshops for One Book: Flipkart's First Order, 2007
conflicts: Starting money: about ₹4 lakh (Sachin Bansal's 2011 interview; Mihir Dalal's book) vs '$8K (INR 5.69 lakh)' (Inc42 2019, apparently a later currency conversion); the story uses ₹4 lakh. 2007 volume: Business Today's 20 shipments vs an unsourced blog's 100 books; the story uses Business Today with attribution.
notes: Episode narrowed to the founding and the first order (late October 2007), told mainly from Sachin's 2011 interview and Binny's quoted recollections (India TV 2015). The first customer is not named. YourStory founder interviews and Flipkart Stories pages could not be used (403 / 'Story Not Found').
